baseline_findings_selecting_cases.peak_regions: t1 weak back-neck warp; t3 weak front-left-cuff warp, peak vertices within45 micrometres of original capsule surfaces
remaining_questions: Can additional fixed zero-G evolution remove the15% failure after completed assembly, or does it persist without gravity?
Does removal of mannequin contact eliminate or materially reduce the zero-G assembly strain while all cloth, meshing, sewing and self-contact settings remain fixed?

cases.name: zero-g-balance
cases.fresh_start: Original document, original mesh positions, zero velocities; deterministic replay of unchanged first60 control frames then exactly120 more zero-G frames
cases.contact: All production original mannequin/ground/self/interpanel contacts remain on
cases.deterministic_prefix_requirement: Positions and velocities exactly match baseline frames0..60; mismatch is retained and invalidates the intended branch comparison
cases.comparison: Independent strain/energy/momentum/velocity/interval impulse at t1,t2,t3; nodal drift from t1; t3 versus baseline gravity. Exactly one fixed2s balance interval, no subsequent blind extension.

cases.name: no-avatar
cases.fresh_start: Load unchanged original fixture; retain original project alongside runtime project; clear mannequin capsules in memory only, assert resulting Mesh exactly equals original mesh, then simulate exactly60 zero-G frames
cases.contact: Original ground/self/interpanel contacts remain on; only analytic mannequin capsules omitted
cases.comparison: Independent t1 peak strain, spatial distribution, elastic energies, closure/seam residuals and momentum versus original t1 baseline. Counterfactual input is solely a causal diagnostic and cannot establish garment-quality or fitting pass.

interpretation_rules: Dropping below15% only in the avatar-free diagnostic supports avatar loading as a causal contributor to this trajectory; it does not justify removing avatars or claiming a product quality pass.

Persistent zero-G strain above15% after fixed2s continuation rejects only the proposition that this particular extra interval resolves the observed failure; it does not prove equilibrium or impossibility.
A change above0.005 in peak strain or0.001m nodal drift is flagged as sensitivity, not convergence or a solver defect.
Report signed material-axis strain, energy and full force limitations; conditional8.73% neck/14.04% cuff uniform extension estimates are not a rigorous15% axis-strain lower bound.
Do not infer force equilibrium from low KE or finite steps; contact reactions and XPBD multipliers are not exported.
saved_observables: Full positions, velocities, settings, diagnostics and timings every public frame
Exact original and runtime project, mesh, UV, masses, boundary/seam source associations
Independent same geometric strain/energy/momentum/force calculations as baseline
Independent conservative membrane/bending/sewing force vectors at frame60 and terminal frame180 where applicable
non_goals: No general convergence, calibration, reference parity or solver-defect claim
No native UI, CI, Pages or public registry changes
